lines.text: Dreaming of the perfect escape by the sea?
Discover Amara Hotel & SPA, where elegance meets relaxation on the beautiful coast of Durrës.
Wake up in elegant, beautifully designed rooms, many offering breathtaking views of the Adriatic Sea!
Indulge in delicious cuisine at our seaside restaurant, where every meal becomes a memorable experience.
Soak up the sunshine by our outdoor swimming pool, or unwind on our private beach, just steps away.
Escape the everyday and restore your senses at our Wellness Center & SPA, your sanctuary of peace and relaxation.
Amara Hotel & SPA. Where comfort meets elegance, and every moment becomes a memory...
